rows.name: COMPUTE-RESTARTS
rows.behavioral_dedup: A condition-filtered, ordered snapshot of all dynamically active restarts including anonymous and shadowed duplicate names; not equal to D8/D9 RESTART-BIND or RESTART-CASE (dynamic binding/control) or FIND-RESTART single-name lookup.
rows.owner_boundary: D10 observational read-only result, D2 retains restart binding, invocation and nonlocal control.
positive_witnesses: For nested same-name restarts and one anonymous restart, compute-restarts includes all three in innermost-first order; find-restart can return only the nearest same-name restart.
Given restarts associated with condition A and an unassociated restart, filtering by unrelated condition B removes A-specific restart but keeps unassociated restart.
falsifiers: Dropping an anonymous restart or a shadowed same-name restart violates the law.
Returning an unrelated-condition-specific restart for condition B or reversing nesting order violates the law.
rows.semantic_law: Read the ordered list of currently active applicable restart objects in the dynamic program environment: newest/innermost first; preserve anonymous restarts and distinct restarts with identical names. With a non-NIL condition, omit restarts associated only with other conditions, while retaining unassociated restarts. Return a list; this read-only observer does not invoke a restart or transfer control.
two_positive_witnesses: Two distinct RESTART-BIND restarts named DUPLICATE must remain two distinct objects, with the more recently established restart first; NIL-named anonymous restart is not discarded.
Nested inner and outer dynamically active restarts appear in inner-to-outer order; leaving the dynamic scope removes the inner restart without modifying the outer.
When a condition object is supplied, an explicitly associated restart for a different condition is excluded but a restart unassociated with any condition remains visible.
falsifier: Implement as FIND-RESTART by symbol: loses duplicate names and anonymous restarts.
Return names only, sort by symbol text, or drop active restart objects.
Include only condition-associated restarts and discard global unassociated restarts, or include restarts associated with other conditions.
Cause an INVOKE-RESTART / transfer control as a side effect of the query.
rows.dependency_derivability: PENDING; do not infer irreducible core primitive from dictionary spelling
rows.d2_control_attack: READ-ONLY query of D2-managed dynamic restart scope; does not create or invoke restarts; ownership review still required
rows.substrate_only_attack: Represent abstract restart objects, not SBCL internal memory format
rows.decision_reason: Read-only dynamic restart discovery is observably distinct from FIND-RESTART (single-name lookup), but D2 environment ownership and core-vs-library remain owner HOLD; proposal alone never SELECT.
